title: Backward doubly stochastic differential equations with or without reflection under weak conditions
summary: In this paper, we study the solvability of backward doubly stochastic differential equations (BDSDEs, for short), both with and without reflection, under weak conditions on the generator. First, when the generator $f$ is of general growth in $y$ and linear growth in $z$, we establish the existence, uniqueness, comparison principle, and the existence of maximal solutions. Second, when $f$ is of linear growth in $y$ and quadratic growth in $z$ with bounded terminal value, we prove the existence, uniqueness, and comparison principle.
